Maria (CSM): FYI - Aurora Labs onboarding hit a big spike of 429s during their staging ramp, flagged by support :grimacing:
Sam (Eng): can you drop their SDK version and a small sample of the response headers? is this preflight or generation?
Maria (CSM): js-sdk v1.4.2, mostly preflight calls. sending a short paste from their staging logs.
Tiago (Aurora Labs): we see bursts when dozens of users open the app simultaneously; every tab does preflight and then requests generation. sample: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-retry-after: 6
{"error":"rate_exceeded","detail":"preflight_burst"}`
Sam (Eng): yep that Retry-After header explains it. are you minting ephemeral tokens per-tab?
Tiago (Aurora Labs): yes, TTL 45s per tab. we tried low TTL to limit blast radius but seems to cause more churn.
Sam (Eng): short TTL + per-tab exchange frequently causes fanout. quick mitigation path: 1) switch to server-side token exchange for initial bootstrap or 2) lengthen TTL to 5m + implement stale refresh so tabs reuse tokens.
Sam (Eng): also add jitter and cap concurrent preflight attempts. small code sample for jittered backoff:
```js
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
const base = 500;
const jitter = () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 300);
await sleep(base * Math.pow(2, attempt) + jitter());
```
Sam (Eng): and gate simultaneous preflights to 2-3 per client process. honor x-rw-retry-after header instead of retrying immediately.
Maria (CSM): customer is sensitive - renewal conversation next month. we need a short runbook and an interim fix ASAP.
Sam (Eng): I'll write a 3-step runbook: 1) temporary: implement client-side queue + respect Retry-After; 2) short-term: set server-side token exchange or increase TTL + stale refresh; 3) long-term: upgrade to SDK v1.5 where `preflightPoolSize` exists or enable server-side preflight coalescing.
Tiago (Aurora Labs): thanks. any SDK flags we can flip in 1.4.2 to help now?
Sam (Eng): not in 1.4.2. you can monkeypatch a small wrapper to debounce token fetches, or upgrade. I'll DM migration notes.
Maria (CSM): can you include a minimal patch we can paste into their code? Cc: account team.
Sam (Eng): yes - sample debounce wrapper + backoff snippet + link to doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/preflight-coalescing. I'll also suggest temporarily enabling a capacity bump for their account if residuals persist.
Tiago (Aurora Labs): applying jitter + respect Retry-After now, will test in staging and report within 2 hours.
deploy-bot: Note: SDK v1.5.0 with preflightPoolSize flag planned for release 2024-11-02.
Tiago (Aurora Labs): quick update - jitter + honoring Retry-After reduced 429s by ~90% in our smoke tests. still a couple under peak ramp. next step is server-side exchange.
Sam (Eng): great improvement. if you still see tail 429s after server-side exchange, we can coordinate a short capacity increase while migrating.
Maria (CSM): logging this under renewal risk tracker until server-side exchange confirms mitigation. thanks team for the quick turnaround :pray:
Tiago (Aurora Labs): will confirm when server-side is live. appreciate the help! :thumbsup:
